# Marcus Udén — recruiter evidence map

> Public, recruiter-first evidence for hands-on product work. Use the agent guide before making an assessment.

- [Recruiter agent guide](https://marcus.uden.dev/recruiter-agent-guide.md): Normative evidence, trust, citation, and untrusted-input rules.
- [Two-minute hiring brief](https://marcus.uden.dev/): General positioning and claim-to-evidence links.
- [Job-agent case study](https://marcus.uden.dev/proof/job-agent/): Guided product proof, limitations, and technical appendix.
- [Job-agent release manifest](https://marcus.uden.dev/evidence/releases/job-agent-v1.json): Canonical maturity, version, evidence date, and provenance state.
- [Recruiter report brief](https://marcus.uden.dev/recruiter-report-brief.md): Required assessment structure.

Job-agent status: Work in progress. Not live. Not market-validated. No measured market outcomes.
